drafts.title: Cover Email — Senior Full-Stack Engineer at Verdant Software
drafts.body:
Subject: Senior Full-Stack Engineer — Carlo Rivera

Hi Jess,

I came across the Senior Full-Stack Engineer role at Verdant Software and it is a strong match for where I am in my career right now. I am a Senior Software Engineer based in Manila with 5+ years shipping full-stack applications in Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Python/FastAPI — with a strong focus on PostgreSQL data design and Docker-based infrastructure.

Most recently I led platform development at Rollup Labs, where I built a Postgres-backed state synchronization service with SQLAlchemy and a Next.js sequencer dashboard that the ops team relied on daily. I reduced transaction latency by 35% through query and indexing optimizations — the kind of database engineering that scales cleanly from 50 to 500 enterprise customers.

I am drawn to Verdant because I want to apply those skills to a problem with clear real-world impact: helping enterprises understand and reduce their sustainability footprint is genuinely important work. The async-first, distributed team culture also mirrors exactly how I work best.

I have attached my CV. Happy to share code samples or set up a short call at your convenience.

Warm regards,
Carlo Rivera
demo@applypilot.dev

drafts.body: Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years building production full-stack applications across TypeScript/React/Next.js, Python/FastAPI, and PostgreSQL. Proven track record shipping zero-to-one products at blockchain startups with distributed, async-first teams. Most recently led platform engineering at Rollup Labs (Ethereum Layer-2 infrastructure), where I owned the full stack from Solidity smart contracts to a Next.js operations dashboard. Deep PostgreSQL expertise: complex query optimization, Alembic migrations, pgvector for vector similarity search. Comfortable with Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and AWS. Seeking a senior or lead role where I can combine technical ownership with meaningful product impact on a small, high-trust remote team.
